messages:
Taylor Nguyen: Quick sync — need to lock a 30m go/no-go for the 2026-03-25 release window. Options: Mon 03/22 4pm PT, Tue 03/23 11am PT, Wed 03/24 8am PT. Which works? Agenda choices: A) Standard gate (smoke + metrics + sign-off), B) Lite (canary only), C) Full (canary + perf + rollback rehearsal). Please reply with slot + agenda preference + canary owner + blockers. Checklist: https://docs.example/release/checklist. @Priya Rao @Alex Kim @Chris Patel please weigh in.

Chris Patel: Tue 03/23 11am PT works for me. Vote: Agenda A. I'll own release notes sanity check. Small blocker: batch-queue PR #487 needs merge before canary.

Priya Rao: Prefer Wed 03/24 8am PT (avoids PM all-hands). Vote: Agenda C — want rollback rehearsal. I'll add backout steps to the checklist. +1 on PR #487 merge deadline.

Alex Kim: SRE here — Tue 03/23 11am ok but can do Wed morning. I'll own canary rollout and smoke tests. Can we reserve a 10-min cache-warm window post-cut?

Jordan Lee: Heads up I'm OOO Mon/Tue afternoon. Wed 8am PT is the only slot that works for me.

Taylor Nguyen: Noting preferences: Chris->Tue, Priya+Jordan->Wed. Looks like Wed 03/24 08:00 PT wins. Agenda C selected. I'll create calendar invite for 30m and attach agenda + checklist. Action items: - Taylor: send invite - Priya: backout doc - Alex: canary + smoke scripts - Chris: merge PR #487 (or flag blocker by EOD Fri 03/19). Everyone: confirm RSVP or add proxy.

DeployBot: Calendar event created: 'Release readiness — 03/24 08:00 PT (30m)'. Link: https://calendar.example/evt/abc123

Chris Patel: :thumbsup: I'll aim to merge #487 by EOD Fri 03/19. If blocked I'll post here and escalate.

Priya Rao: Added rollback steps to the checklist: https://docs.example/release/backout. Also added a 'rehearsal' subsection with play-by-play.

Alex Kim: Canary script repo/job: https://ci.example/canary-run (job: release-canary). I'll run a dry run Tue afternoon and paste results.

Taylor Nguyen: Quick logistics note: we'll do 5m status + 20m validation + 5m decision. If decision = go, we'll trigger the automated pipeline with tag `release-2026-03-25`. Please RSVP in the invite or assign a proxy.

Jordan Lee: Proxy confirmed: @Sam Ortiz will cover for me if I'm delayed.

Sam Ortiz: Noted. I'll be on standby and have deploy key access.

Taylor Nguyen: Thanks all — I'll follow up once RSVPs hit ~80% or by EOD tomorrow. :party-parrot:
